description.en: Independent DeepSeek Harness plugins by ZJ929-max: tool folding, read-only Bilibili lookup, extra image formats, cross-session messaging, and TokenEconomizer. Every version is pinned to a 40-hex commit.
description.zh: ZJ929-max 维护的独立 DSH 插件：低频工具折叠、只读 B 站查询、更多图片格式、跨会话消息、TokenEconomizer。每个版本都固定到 40 位 commit。

description.en: Three read-only Bilibili tools that run only when called: search, video info, and hot comments. No login, no timer, no posting, no browser.
description.zh: 只在被调用时才读 B 站的三个工具：搜索、看视频信息、读热门评论。不登录、不定时、不发评论、不碰浏览器。

description.en: view_image converts JXL, AVIF, HEIC/HEIF, BMP and TIFF (PSD with ImageMagick) to PNG and returns the image block. Read-only, cached, width-capped.
description.zh: view_image：把 jxl / avif / heic / heif / bmp / tiff（psd 需 ImageMagick）转成 PNG 后返回图像块。只读、带缓存、长边限幅。

description.en: Cross-session messaging inside one DSH profile: post with optional wake:false, inbox, and peer status. Rate-limited anti-ping-pong; a paused send returns ok:false.
description.zh: 同一 profile 内的跨会话消息：投递（可只投递不唤醒）、收件箱、对等会话状态；限速防对喷，被限速时返回 ok:false。

description.en: Ports three money-saving mechanisms from microsoft/TokenEconomizer to DSH: repository facts across sessions, failure-loop intervention, and tool-pruning evidence. No model calls.
description.zh: 把 microsoft/TokenEconomizer 的三套省钱机制移植到 DSH：跨会话仓库事实、同轮重复失败转向提示、工具裁剪证据。不额外调用模型。索引单列，不随元包安装。
